verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a datacenter GPU accelerator, so a built-in AI assistant that takes delegated tasks is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows AMD shipping such an assistant in the GPU or its tooling. The 'AI-native job scheduler' (Spur) is a workload scheduler rather than an assistant users delegate tasks to, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
